name: Fri. 13/11 - Maria Pistolas
description: This event, titled "Fri. 13/11 - Maria Pistolas," takes place at Maria Pistolas in Porto. It features music genres such as Funk, R&B, Reggaeton, and House.
longDescription:
The event "Fri. 13/11 - Maria Pistolas" is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at Maria Pistolas in Porto. The party starts at 11:55 PM and continues until 6:00 AM.

Attendees can expect a mix of Funk, R&B, Reggaeton, and House music. Tickets are available with various options, starting from €5.00 for entry without consumption, up to €15.00 which includes one drink.

The venue is located at Praça de Dona Filipa de Lencastre 175, 4050-000 Porto, Portugal. Tickets can be secured through Shotgun, with an option to resell them if plans change.
